name: Hybrid 2D/3D Registration Optimization Pipeline
definition: A two-stage optimization pipeline for 2D/3D registration that first minimizes a differentiable network similarity loss ($L_N$) for global convergence, then switches to a traditional Grad-NCC loss ($L_{GNNC}$) for local refinement.
summary: This two-stage pipeline estimates 2D X-ray to 3D CT pose by combining network similarity loss for global convergence with Grad-NCC for local refinement, ensuring robustness to local texture ambiguities.
